clippings.speaker: John Lasseter
clippings.quote: It’s got a great emotional arc. It’s exactly what we’re looking for.
clippings.title: Composer Randy Newman Drives Huge Orchestra for 'Cars 3' Score
clippings.context: Said to Newman in the booth at a Cars 3 recording session, which Variety attended, after Lasseter arrived halfway through.

clippings.speaker: John Lasseter
clippings.quote: He never speaks down to an audience in either the songs or the score. It’s always from an adult point of view.
clippings.title: White Man With Attitude
clippings.context: Lasseter, a Pixar director and frequent co-worker, explaining in a profile why he chose Newman to score kid-oriented films.

clippings.speaker: Randy Newman
clippings.quote: Lasseter was also involved. He was a first-time director but he had definite opinions about things. If I disagreed, I’d tell him I did.
clippings.title: Monsters, Inc.'s Composer Randy Newman: “I score because I care!”
clippings.context: Interview by Jérémie Noyer, answering how he worked with Pete Docter on Monsters, Inc.; Newman describes the director's role on the score.

notes: Newman-about-Lasseter is thin: the WOUB 2016 line is junket-level and the Ringer and Oscar speech quotes are not about Newman, so only one usable quote. Skipped the UDiscover citation of a 2001 LA Times quote because the original headline could not be confirmed. The Princess and the Frog DVD interview has no transcript.
